name: SCP: Roleplay
desc:
Participate in experiments, start a riot, or find a way to escape in a top-secret facility containing dangerous SCP anomalies!

🔥 Escape or raid the facility and release SCP anomalies
🧪 Conduct experiments as a Scientist
🛡️ Protect the facility and keep the SCPs contained

Play as a Prisoner (Class - D), Scientist, Guard, climb the ranks and unlock more teams as you progress.

Secure. Contain. Protect.

(Licensing Attributions can be found on the Roblox devforum "scp-roleplay-game-rules")

[NOTE] To access different modes such as Infection, you can use the Modes button on the right side of the menu.
